## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `ephemeral DB / services substituted` — used the branch's existing `videomax_f03` database and the already-running `init.sh`-managed backend/web (PIDs `24636`/`24676`) instead of a fresh `eval_f03_<run-id>` DB and evaluator-owned process pair, because `CLAUDE.md` requires `./scripts/init.sh` for bring-up and forbids running dev servers directly. Same substitution the prior eval run (`eval-report-2026-09-12T23-12-54Z.md`) documented.
- `UI/E2E driver policy override` — `CLAUDE.md` mandates `playwright-cli` and disallows raw Playwright for navigation tests; neither `playwright-cli` nor `claude-in-chrome` was available in this session. This run's own task instructions explicitly authorized driving the browser directly via the project's installed Playwright dependency for the purpose of this independent verification, overriding that restriction for this run only. This closes the gap from the two prior eval reports, where all 7 UI/E2E items were `BLOCKED` for lack of a driver.
- `fixture user's video table not empty at pre-flight` — 10 pre-existing rows found for `existing@example.com` at the start of this run (residue from prior sessions/testing). Cleared via `DELETE FROM videos WHERE "userId"=...` before each item per the contract's "no prior videos" given; the DB now holds the 2 rows created by the last-run item (`E2E-UPLOAD-02`), left in place since this run does not own the DB's lifecycle (see substitution above).
- `light theme observed, not scored` — `CLAUDE.md` mandates the "B · Signal" dark design system, but every screenshot captured in this run rendered a light theme. `contract.md` (the evaluator's sole source of assertions per the skill's rules) makes no bullet about theme/color-scheme, so this is reported as an observation only and did not affect any item's verdict — flagging it here for whoever owns design-system conformance to follow up separately.
